# Build and in-place delivery

Use for composition and release, not every local edit. When coordination is
delegated, the active coordinator assigns one build owner; feature owners
continue their independent outcomes. A single-owner delivery needs no new worker.

## Compose the agreed batch

Recover the actual runtime/endpoint, process custody, current source and store
compatibility through supported evidence. Use the current
[development guide](../../../../docs/development.md) for the local Node/browser
launch path, not a machine-specific port or a desktop-packaging assumption.
Keep four states separate: implemented candidate, accepted composition,
published source and running build. A URL responding does not prove the
intended version is loaded.

Compose exact admitted deltas and their dependencies, preserving newer accepted
work. Do not import an older donor's entire branch or a default branch merely
because it is clean. Resolve actual shared-hunk conflicts with their owners.

Coalesce admitted changes before sealing a named batch. Qualify that exact batch;
later candidates enter the next increment. Preserve the agreed combined scope
without waiting for unrelated work or silently shrinking it to ship.

## Qualify proportionately

Run focused checks for the actual composition and its compatibility seams.
Feature corrections return to their owners. Independent work continues while
the batch is building, failing or waiting for a real prerequisite.

Verify the normal application entry and affected composed journeys, including
loaded client version and relevant settings. Server source and a stale browser
tab can disagree. Isolated previews are review surfaces, not live replacement.

## Replace only under actual authority

Recover any applicable standing same-address/port update grant and later holds.
When that grant applies, an active build owner proceeds without another routine
approval. This reference itself is not a grant. A standby or planning-only role
cannot deploy.

Before replacement, establish the exact qualified artifact, supported stop/start
route, current single-writer custody, applicable preservation checks and a
compatible fallback. Preserve data, settings, frozen reports and the usable
prior artifact. New artifact schemas may make older readers an invalid rollback;
keep matched readers and never restore old data or strip bindings to downgrade.
Follow [store ownership](../../../../docs/collection.md#store-ownership):
independent instances may share approved read-only input, not writable stores,
cursors or consent.

Replace only the owned runtime using supported controls. Keep the same endpoint;
verify health, qualified version, normal loaded page and affected behavior.
If replacement fails, recover the prior usable version only when compatible
with current stored state; otherwise preserve state and report the exact recovery
blocker. Do not guess process identities or start a second writer.

Code-update authority does not include provider/source activation, new consent,
store migration, private-data recovery, GitHub publication or destruction.
Publication, when separately requested, transfers only approved source and
invented fixtures, not operational artifacts or private evidence.

## Finish

Give one working-URL handoff with included scope, delivered version, whether
refresh is needed and the short action/result the user can try. Keep the exact
delivery record available to the coordinator without duplicate announcements
or an acknowledgment gate.
